about.title: About Me
about.content: I build robust, scalable web applications using WordPress, PHP, Laravel, and modern JavaScript frameworks. With 15+ years of full-stack experience, I specialize in developing custom WordPress solutions, RESTful APIs, and database-driven systems. I'm passionate about writing clean, maintainable code, implementing secure authentication systems, and delivering responsive, cross-browser compatible interfaces. I craft reliable backend architectures while ensuring seamless frontend user experiences.

clinton.title: Clinton Foundation Digital Platform
clinton.description: As part of Radish Lab's development team, contributed to redesigning the Clinton Foundation's website. Implemented modular WordPress architecture with WCAG AA accessibility standards, custom mega menu navigation, and flexible content management system supporting multiple program areas.

red.title: (RED) Partnership Platform
red.description: Collaborated with Radish Lab team to refine (RED)'s Squarespace platform for global health partnerships. Developed custom JavaScript modules, integrated donation systems with performance optimization and SEO best practices.

wrc.title: Women's Refugee Commission
wrc.description: Part of Radish Lab team that migrated WRC from Joomla to WordPress. Contributed to rebuilding the resource library with custom post types and advanced taxonomy, implemented thematic navigation architecture, and integrated analytics tracking for decades of advocacy publications.

tcf.title: The Century Foundation
tcf.description: Part of Radish Lab team that redesigned The New York Community Trust's digital platform. Contributed to developing responsive mega menu system, building modular component-based CMS architecture, and implementing WCAG AA accessibility standards while consolidating three regional websites into unified experience.
